intro: The shrug kaomoji ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ — often called the "shruggie" — is a Japanese-style text face that says "I don't know" or "whatever" with raised arms. It is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and chats. Browse the classic shrug and its variants below and click any to copy it instantly. Whether you search "shrug kaomoji," "kaomoji shrug," or just "shrug emoji," every face here is free to copy and paste.
